research_question: Does the broad residual overlay clear the gates after exact V3 replacement buys are reconstructed from their PIT inventory rows instead of merely recording a symbol allowlist?

data_contract.failure_driven_change_from_round51: the frozen-entry helper now replaces a selected row with the actual baseline replacement symbol's same-day PIT inventory row and retains the original rank allocation; missing inventory is a hard error
data_contract.entry_ledger_freeze: every candidate V3 buy uses the frozen baseline signal day, actual symbol, rank and executed share count; external information cannot create, remove or resize an entry
data_contract.liquidity_priority: fund frozen V3 entries first from weakest prior-close ordinary positions, then recall externally deferred positions
data_contract.exit_timing: all substitution and recall choices use prior-close state and execute at the current close

boundary.entry_set_and_size: exact frozen V3 executed-buy ledger including affordable replacements

model.target: 30-day deferred-exit close return minus frozen mechanical-exit close return
model.target_availability: deferred label joins only after its exit day is strictly before the current decision
model.core_features: position path, rank and V3 entry price-volume features
model.full_features: core plus PIT global, SW L1, macro and official-event features
model.external_increment: full ridge prediction minus core ridge prediction

selection.standout_gate: at least 10 percent relative return improvement, or one fewer negative month together with improved drawdown
selection.robustness_requirement: formal pass still requires trigger concentration, leave-one-trigger-out and an untouched forward account window
